name: Demogorgon

skins.name: The rake
skins.lore: The The Rake skin references the creature from the famous internet creepypasta known for its pale appearance, animalistic behavior, and terrifying nighttime attacks.

skins.name: ReAnimen
skins.lore: The ReAnimen skin references the cyborg undead soldiers created by D.A. Sinclair in Invincible using dead bodies enhanced with mechanical upgrades.

skins.name: Alien
skins.lore: The Alien skin references the Xenomorph from the Alien film franchise, one of the most iconic extraterrestrial monsters in science fiction horror.

skins.name: Wolverimne
skins.lore: The Wolverimne skin references Wolverine from Marvel Comics, the mutant hero known for his claws, regeneration, and feral fighting style.

skins.name: hyde
skins.lore: The hyde skin references Tyler Galpin from Wednesday after awakening his inherited Hyde transformation. Manipulated by Laurel Gates, Tyler became her controlled monster and committed multiple murders as part of her revenge plan against the outcasts of Nevermore.

lore: The Demogorgon is a terrifying creature from Stranger Things, originating from the Upside Down. Known for its predatory instincts, sharp claws, powerful bite, and ability to move through portals, it hunts with brutal aggression and monstrous speed.
